input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: The cap is expressly mutual, § 21.2 excludes indirect and consequential damages for "neither Party", and the retained Excluded Claims definition already places indemnification, confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP outside the cap. The single material failure is the cap basis: "Fees" is defined at §§ 1.5-1.6 as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee and § 21.1 confines the measure to the first Order Form, so the twelve-month formula is illusory and falls below the walk-away line. We therefore target the fallback with one surgical edit resetting the basis to fees paid or payable under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, with a USD 1,000,000 floor, which completes every fallback element. We deliberately leave § 21.3 alone: broadening its payment carve-out beyond "undisputed amounts for conforming Services" is a preferred-only refinement that would expand our uncapped exposure to disputed and non-conforming amounts, so we note it rather than press it.

proposal.summary: Single edit to § 21.1: mutual cap measured by 12 months' fees under the Agreement and all Order Forms, with a USD 1,000,000 floor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap of at least 12 months' fees, but the basis as drafted is illusory because "Fees" is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form. We have reset only the cap basis in § 21.1 to fees paid or payable under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, with a USD 1,000,000 floor; the mutual cap, the mutual exclusion of indirect damages and the Excluded Claims carve-outs (indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct) are untouched.
